apply.text: You press a fingertip to the wax. The scores are colder than the lead, and the room seems briefly taller.

outcome.continuity_note: A thumb-sized sounding lead whose scored wax suggests salt, wear, and uncertain scale without opening a passage or naming an actor. Inspect and apply vary with sanity, insight, charges, and prior state, shifting only a small allowed sanity delta.
outcome.inspect: A thumb-sized lead. Pale wax in its base holds fine parallel scores, too regular for a pocket scratch.
outcome.name: Salt-scored Pocket Lead

apply.text: You look composed in it. The composure cools your hand as you shut it.

outcome.continuity_note: A gilt pocket glass that returns a more finished face than the one offered, leaving hand or light slightly poorer. Inspection shifts with wear, brightness, composure, or a visible edit; use may steady, chill, or only agree. Repeated looking lets the smile start early. Hooks stay finite: no quest, attribute, or hidden fact.
outcome.inspect: A palm glass in gilt. Your face looks finished; the room behind does not.
outcome.name: Gilt Pocket Glass

apply.text: You count along the hem: twelve, then a thirteenth you did not feel under your thumb.

outcome.continuity_note: A mended cuff in brown hemstitch. Recounting shifts one proud stitch, and the interval will not stay fixed. Setting the count aside can steady attention; low composure lets the eye supply a stitch the cloth does not confirm. The discrepancy stays local, ambiguous, and unresolved.
outcome.inspect: Brown hemstitch on a narrow cuff. One stitch rides a little high, as if the needle paused.
outcome.name: Running Stitch Cuff

apply.text: You read RIGHT, then LEFT. Turning the glove only exchanges which word begins. The nap is still new.

outcome.continuity_note: Original object: one kid glove whose cuff and back name opposite hands. Four readings reverse expectation in turn: a swap, a mutual reference, then an agreement that fails to settle. High insight makes stitch totals refuse to add; low sanity lets the fit seem briefly steady. The hooks return only a line, a state, and a small sanity delta.
outcome.inspect: The cuff says RIGHT. The back says LEFT. Neither side is blank, nor wrong alone.
outcome.name: the cuff-note glove

apply.text: You turn the card. The last line now reads: before the interval.

outcome.continuity_note: A cream program card with one frayed corner. Hooks vary by state, sanity, insight, and charges: the last line moves from after the interval to before it, then to a missing word and a pale gap, then to a small repeated discrepancy. Lower sanity texts draw the gap nearer; higher insight texts note ink that never entered the fibers. Deltas remain in range. The motif is invented; no borrowed myth, quest, or unseen agent.
outcome.inspect: A cream card, frayed at one corner. The last line reads: after the interval.
outcome.name: Frayed Program Card

apply.text: You set the long arm flat. The short arm meets late by less than a shaving.

outcome.continuity_note: A palm-sized brass mitre whose inner corner joins a breath late. Alignment, turn, and press change the reading with sanity, insight, charges, and prior state, always on the metal and inside a limited frame. Proposal summary only: not a placement, not a sighting.
outcome.inspect: A palm brass mitre. Both inner edges meet, yet the join is a breath late.
outcome.name: Late-Join Mitre

apply.text: You turn the cup. Wax flakes. The coil looks ordinary until you blink; then it is too long for the hollow again.

outcome.continuity_note: Thumb-sized pitted lead sounding cup; waxed thread occupies the wrong space. Wear and isolation hint at uncertain scale without a passage, pursuer, or place. Inspect and apply vary by sanity, insight, charges, and state. If insight is 0 and sanity is high, the first reading is salt-crust and a blink-length fault; later state dulls it; low sanity treats the weight as familiar; high insight swells the pits toward a coast that collapses to salt. Deltas remain in -2..2. Editorial summary of a proposal only.
outcome.inspect: A thumb cup of pitted lead. Salt crusts the rim. Inside, waxed thread is coiled tighter than the hollow allows.
outcome.name: Pitted Sounding Cup

apply.text: Violet and closet-dust. A name nearly forms, then fails into a thumb-smudge.

outcome.continuity_note: An ivory calling card: gilt worn thin, script that will not settle, a name left unfinished. Inspection marks a dry wetness, a dog-ear that seems to have shifted, or the same omitted stroke. Each handling revises that omission and may change sanity by a small bounded amount, briefly steadying a frayed mind or costing a little composure. Nothing beyond the card is claimed.
outcome.inspect: Stiff cream card, edges gilt to a whisper. The script will not settle into a name.
outcome.name: Ivory Calling Card

apply.text: You smooth the scrap. Three faint strokes, and a margin drawn as if the count were already settled.

outcome.continuity_note: Ruled-scrap curio: a hard margin beside a short faint tally. Hooks set that confident account against the smaller count the ink supports. Early use notes the mismatch and unsettles slightly; low sanity lets the sure line feel truer than the marks, steadier sanity may answer with a small calm, and high insight only sharpens the gap. No crowd, authority, quest, or placement is claimed.
outcome.inspect: A ruled scrap. The margin is drawn hard; beside it, three faint strokes and no more.
outcome.name: The Sure Margin

apply.text: You pinch the loose thread flat. It rises again, one stitch farther along.

outcome.continuity_note: A palm-sized pressed linen card whose margin stitch will not keep one count. Looking stays sensory; the repeat shifts only under attention and can be set down. Use presses the loose thread, settles a total, or leaves the count unfinished, with a small sanity change tied to that choice. No diagnosis or further claim is made.
outcome.inspect: Pressed linen, palm-sized. The margin stitch is even. One pale thread lifts at the corner.
outcome.name: counted margin card

apply.text: Ink and wax both show 1. The match is real and explains nothing. You leave it.

outcome.continuity_note: A narrow paper slip keeps one wax pip while its ink tally rises with handling. An early match can resemble agreement; later figures show a confident count leaving the only mark behind. What it yields depends on that gap, on steadiness, and on insight. It claims no crowd, authority, or further revelation.
outcome.inspect: Thumb-blurred paper, one wax pip, and an ink tally that also says 1. The wax is still soft.
outcome.name: Sure Tally Slip

apply.text: You set it flush to the floor. The corner refuses to be one. Certainty thins.

outcome.continuity_note: A bone set-square whose inner right angle is a hair wider than the outer. Inspection stays on that surface mismatch and shifts with remaining use, repetition, composure, and whether a second name for the gap is at hand. Application records the refusal, a press that reopens by the same hair, then a choice to keep both measures inside one frame. Later handling adds no further claim. No extra dimension, map fact, or quest is stated.
outcome.inspect: A thin bone set-square. The inner corner is a hair wider than the outer.
outcome.name: Unclosed Set-Square

apply.text: You trace four edges. The groove closes late, by less than a thumbnail.

outcome.continuity_note: A palm tin square with one groove that closes slightly late, so a careful count never quite finishes inside its own frame. Inspection shifts with composure, insight, remaining attention, and how often the groove has been followed. Application only advances that private tally and a small sanity change. No new direction, place, or later event is claimed.

apply.text: You turn it once. The face that was down says THIS SIDE UP, as the first face did.

apply.text: You put it on. The right hand enters a left label without tearing a stitch. The fit is polite, and wrong.

outcome.continuity_note: A cotton glove with a stitched LEFT label that does not agree with the thumb it was cut for. Inspect and apply turn that mismatch through reversible, exact readings: both sides, stitch totals, and which statement came first. Small sanity shifts follow relief or a tighter contradiction. No power, quest, or hidden fact is claimed, and no presentation is assumed.

outcome.name: Other-Hand Label

apply.text: You turn the screw. Salt grit speaks, not the brass. The tips halt, and the halt feels slightly too long.

outcome.continuity_note: A salt-fretted pocket caliper whose jaws stop short. Sanity, insight, charges, and state shift the wording from grit and wear toward an unconfirmed sense of distance. No passage, pursuer, or later event is asserted.

outcome.name: Saltbit Caliper

apply.text: Never opened, it is eager. In the glass you are kinder, and that kindness smiles first.

outcome.continuity_note: A tortoiseshell vanity glass whose silvering agrees a fraction early: a polished compliment that smiles before consent. Inspection stays sensory and shifts with frayed composure, a tired case, or recognition of the pose. outcome.inspect: Palm-sized tortoiseshell, warm as a kept secret. The silvering agrees before you have spoken.
outcome.name: Late Vanity Glass

apply.text: You open it. Blank cards. The lid composes you more finely than life.

outcome.continuity_note: A silver card case whose lid briefly composes a kinder face, then withholds the favor. Each opening only shifts that courtesy and a small composure delta. No identity, status, or later event is claimed.

outcome.name: Silver Card Case

apply.text: You turn the spare peg where no string asks it. The click is clean, and the streak jumps too far.

outcome.continuity_note: A pale spare peg whose weight is short of a round bore and straight grain. The pale streak is the recurring measure: looks quarrel over aim, memory, and bore, and each handling lets the click and the streak disagree a little more. outcome.name: Hollow Peg

apply.text: On the stone the fourth corner closes for one breath. Lifted, the join is gone, and the brass is cool.

outcome.continuity_note: A palm-sized brass square whose fourth corner misses by a fraction composure can dismiss and repetition makes exact. Hooks describe only that disagreement, a reading count, and a small sanity delta. No further plane is entered or promised. Supplied role and scores are context, not placement or discovery.
outcome.inspect: A palm-wide brass square. Three corners meet cleanly. The fourth looks closed until the light is still.
outcome.name: Unclosed Square

apply.text: You turn it. Counted none, it answers four, as if polite.

outcome.continuity_note: An unsewn bone button. A look gives a hole-count already at odds with a second look, and says which face is out. A turn stores the opposite count; two alone stays two, so the rule fails by holding. The unease stays with the button and makes no farther claim.
outcome.inspect: A bone button on bare thread. It has none holes, until recounted.
outcome.name: The Contrary Button

apply.text: You press the stray loop flat. It springs back, one hole to the left.

outcome.continuity_note: A stiff card of brown darning wool whose printed grid and loops disagree by a half-stitch. Attention moves which hole looks empty; the mismatch stays domestic and unexplained. Steadier handling can call it a mill error, or set the card down and keep the count.
outcome.inspect: Brown wool on a stiff card. One loop sits a half-stitch left of its printed hole.
outcome.name: Darning Wool Card

apply.text: You draw the knot in. Tar flakes. The cord in your palm does not lengthen, yet the knot arrives late.

outcome.inspect: Thumb-length tarred cord, one salt-swollen knot. Flat, it is near. Tipped, the knot seems a pace away.
outcome.name: Salt-Knotted Fathom Cord

apply.text: You hum the doubled bar. The second inking does not quite match your pitch.

outcome.continuity_note: A cream scrap of staff paper carries one doubled bar that nearly cadences and then withholds the stem. Six phases repeat that omission, shifting with state, sanity, insight, and charges. Unease stays sensory; no borrowed myth, no errand, and no claim of finding or use.
outcome.inspect: A cream scrap of staff paper. One bar is inked twice, as if the hand doubted its close.
outcome.name: Unresolved Measure

apply.text: You draw it through empty air. Orange-flower, then a colder thread of scent.

outcome.continuity_note: A pallid ivory comb missing one tooth. Inspect and apply vary by charges, sanity, insight, and prior state: orange-flower thins toward a polished absence that never quite coheres. Small sanity deltas only; no quest, grant, or hidden fact is claimed.
outcome.inspect: Pallid ivory, one tooth gone. A trace of orange-flower clings to the spine.
outcome.name: Pallid Ivory Comb

apply.text: You press the fissure with a nail. A cold tick answers, then nothing.

outcome.continuity_note: A pale bone bodkin is reread through a hairline fissure. Inspection and application retune that same detail by sanity, insight, charges, and a short state cycle: early ticks unsettle, measuring steadies nothing, and later composure may briefly make the crack seem ordinary. Deltas stay inside the allowed range. No quest, placement, or hidden fact is asserted.
outcome.inspect: A pale bone bodkin. Its fissure is thinner than a hair, and quite still.
outcome.name: pale bodkin

apply.text: The card returns the face you would rather keep. A precise vanity leaves the wrist.

outcome.continuity_note: Pocket ivory and a wafer of glass flatter by one precise degree. Inspection answers present sanity, insight, charges, and consultation state; application returns only a small composure change for keeping the preferred face, flinching from a late smile, or merely seeing the edit. Repetition alters that change. No discovery or later event is described.
outcome.inspect: A calling-card of glass in ivory. It brightens the face a moment before the face arrives.
outcome.name: Ivory Courtesy Card

apply.text: You accept the total. Assent sits on the paper more heavily than the marks do.

outcome.continuity_note: A ledger scrap whose dark total outruns its margin ticks. Inspection contrasts confident ink with a short physical count as sanity, insight, charges, and tally state shift. Application either assents to the figure or trusts the marks, with a small sanity delta and a state that records how far the two accounts diverge. No crowd, authority, placement, or later event is asserted.
outcome.inspect: A fresh slip states forty-one in dark ink. The margin ticks look too few for that ease.
outcome.name: Margin Tally

apply.text: You turn the button. The lint measures one stitch longer than the gap it crosses.

outcome.continuity_note: A bone coat-button whose caught lint will not hold one measure. Looking and turning revise that small discrepancy by sanity, insight, charges, and how often it has already been handled. The only mechanical result is a bounded sanity shift.
outcome.inspect: A bone button, four holes. Lint between two is a stitch longer than the gap.
outcome.name: Crooked Bone Button

apply.text: Cold brass at the ear: a faint scrape, spaced like surf, though no water is in the room.

outcome.continuity_note: A salt-pitted brass sounding-cup, lip worn bright. Inspection only notes wear and a depth that does not fit the metal; each listen advances a wear counter and shifts sanity slightly: unease while steady, a harsher drop if strained, a small steadiness if nearly frayed. The slow grit suggests distance and isolation without becoming a passage, an actor, or a find.
outcome.inspect: A thumb-sized brass cup, salt-pitted. The lip is worn bright, and one pit looks deeper than the metal is thick.
outcome.name: Pitted Sounding-Cup

apply.text: You set the card flat. The gap stays a gap. Your thumb finds no burr, only air where a corner should be.

outcome.continuity_note: A pale bone card scored with four hairlines that almost close a square; one corner stays open by less than the thickness. Inspect and apply vary by sanity, insight, charges, and stored state: a precise gap, a joint that seems to shift, or a depth the card should not hold. Low sanity unsettles; higher insight can recast the fault as a limit of measure. Deltas stay in range. No map, trait, or later event is claimed.
outcome.inspect: Four hairlines on pale bone nearly close a square. One corner holds a gap thinner than the card.
outcome.name: unclosed square

apply.text: A thin note leaves the pipe, flat by a hair. The flatness lingers in the teeth longer than the sound.

outcome.continuity_note: A warped brass pitch-pipe. One dent and one slightly flat note gather pressure under repeated attention, shifting with sanity, insight, charges, and prior state. A steadier misreading can briefly ease the discrepancy before it returns. No quest or hidden fact is claimed.
outcome.inspect: A dented brass pitch-pipe. Cold metal, and a bore that smells faintly of borrowed breath.
outcome.name: Warped Pitch-Pipe

apply.text: You draw the ribbon taut. A pitch sounds, a hair flat, and stops before the bar ends.

outcome.continuity_note: A small black score-ribbon marking a rest no bar contains. Each sounding repeats one hair-flat pitch; the discrepancy recurs and nearly coheres, but is never given a name or an agent. Deltas stay inside the allowed range, and the lines claim no quest, map fact, or extra effect.
outcome.inspect: A narrow black ribbon marks a rest the bar does not contain. The silk is cool.
outcome.name: Pale Cadence Ribbon

apply.text: You turn the square a quarter. Light slides off. The lateness only changes seats.

outcome.continuity_note: A palm-sized brass square whose last corner seems to arrive late. Looking names the lag; turning moves it from edge to edge, and on every fourth hold the outline briefly agrees. Composure may dismiss the fault; closer notice or frayed calm makes the same flat brass harder to keep flat. Nothing beyond that small shift is claimed.
outcome.inspect: A palm-sized brass square. Four edges meet, yet the last corner is a breath late.
outcome.name: unclosed square

apply.text: You start again from the right. Five lines. The sixth is still under your thumb, uncounted and present.

outcome.continuity_note: A nameless visiting-card ruled in tenths, whose ends disagree by one line. Inspection states that discrepancy; application reverses which end is trusted. Calm attention is slightly unsettled, reversal may leave the quarrel unchanged, and ceasing to correct it can ease a low mind by one. Insight at or above 500 can make an even-faced statement sharper by two. The script never spends charges or asserts placement, discovery, or a later quest. Public glance supplied: sanity 100, insight 0, Wizard.
outcome.inspect: An uncreased visiting-card, ruled and nameless. Counted from the left, six lines. From the right, the last line is not there.
outcome.name: Contrary Visiting-Card

apply.text: You open it. The glass improves you by a courtesy so small you almost thank it.

outcome.continuity_note: A mother-of-pearl powder compact whose mirror is a half-step kinder than the face above it. Looking records only state and a small sanity shift: the improved angle usually costs composure, while a frayed bearer may briefly match the arranged expression. Later states make the courtesy early rather than grand. No quest, attribute, or hidden fact is offered.
outcome.inspect: A slim case of mother-of-pearl. The clasp is cool, and too willing to be opened.
outcome.name: Mother-of-Pearl Compact

apply.text: You thumb the groove. A small sure yes arrives, then has nowhere to sit.

outcome.continuity_note: A pocket bone chip with one groove: modest evidence set against the urge to treat it as a fair tally. Inspection and use change with sanity, insight, charges, and how often it has been pressed. A confident reading can slip; a badly frayed one may steady a little when the invented account thins. No crowd, authority, or further errand is established.
outcome.inspect: Thumb-polished bone, one shallow groove. It looks settled. The settlement is only shine.
outcome.name: Worn Claque Bone

apply.text: You turn the weight. Eleven ribs, then twelve. Same cloth. You set it down uncounted.

outcome.continuity_note: A cloth-covered lead hem-weight whose weave-count shifts under repeated attention. Composure may name the spare rib as nap and set the object by its lead; strain finds the mismatch has moved. The watcher can stop counting. No diagnosis, no borrowed room, no promised disclosure.
outcome.inspect: A cloth-covered lead slug for a hem. The ribs of the weave look even.
outcome.name: Cloth Hem-Weight

apply.text: Held to the ear: silence, then a tick for a moment already gone. Blood, or not blood.

outcome.continuity_note: A spare metronome tooth whose tick arrives after the hand is still. Repeated listening shifts the gap: an unfinished bar nearly coheres, then fails. Higher insight almost names that omission a fourth silence, without explaining it. Fragile recurrence in a Chambers register; no borrowed myth and no promised sequel.
outcome.inspect: A slim brass tooth, cool as a key. The tick comes only after your hand is still.
outcome.name: Spare Metronome Tooth

apply.text: You make the same turn. The reading trades three for five; the notch stays. Ease takes the rudeness ill. The ink answers quickly.

outcome.continuity_note: A paper tailor's strip whose one notch is inked three and also five. Looking reports the current reversible reading, shaded by composure, ink willingness, and whether any insight has started to infer a rule. The same turn cycles a four-beat contradiction of readings; after the last beat it reads as unturned without being the first look. Ease nicks only a little, or steadies when composure is already low. No quest or hidden fact is asserted.
outcome.inspect: As if unturned: one notch is inked three, and also five. The quarrel is polite. Ink looks wet.
outcome.name: Twice-Marked Strip

apply.text: You attempt a count. The strokes withhold it. The missing total feels almost proper to believe.

outcome.continuity_note: A shop tally-slip with three pencil strokes and a thumb-blot. Inspect stays with that modest evidence, varying by charges, insight, sanity, and prior handling. Apply is a private attempt to complete a sum the marks withhold; repetition thickens conviction without new evidence. Insight at or above 500 refuses the total; sanity below 40 accepts it. No crowd, event, or authority is claimed.
outcome.inspect: A narrow shop slip. Three faint strokes, a grey thumb-mark. Nothing else contests them.
outcome.name: Smudged Reckoning-Slip

apply.text: You turn the chip. A grit of salt comes off, and the room feels briefly farther from the floor.

outcome.continuity_note: A palm-sized scrap of sounding lead with a salt-stiff cord knot. Inspection shifts with wear-state, sanity, insight, and charges; application advances that state and may change sanity by a small bounded amount.
outcome.inspect: A thumb of pitted lead, cord-knot still through it. The pits look deeper than the piece is thick.
outcome.name: Pitted sounding chip

apply.text: You free the end. It comes too easily, and a pale fiber clings where only black should lie.

outcome.continuity_note: Original curio: a bone spool of black silk troubled by one pale fiber and an unreliable count of turns. Inspection rereads the same end, fiber, or knot according to sanity, insight, charges, and recorded state. Apply walks a short sequence from tucked end to drawn fiber to fiber wound from sight to a knot that may have been finished by the hand, then only rechecks the count. Small sanity deltas match a slip or a brief steadiness. Nothing beyond that glance is promised.
outcome.inspect: A bone spool of black silk. The loose end lies tucked. You are not sure it was tucked before.
outcome.name: Uncounted Silk Spool

apply.text: The silvering offers a finer you. You accept. Taste, it seems, invoices the original.

outcome.continuity_note: A chipped gilt hand-glass whose silvering offers a slightly finer face than the skin warrants. Inspection shifts among a polite discrepancy, a late smile, a spent hinge, a painted seam, or a remembered angle as sanity, insight, charges, and use-state change. outcome.name: Gilt Hand-Glass

apply.text: You seat three corners. The fourth rises by a margin too even to be a dent.

Inspection and use keep finding the same exact margin, and the wording shifts with attention, clarity, and steadiness while remaining inside a bounded frame of reference. The discrepancy is not explained, and no further place is opened or promised.

apply.text: You count seven. A crease hides the end stitch, then does not. It slips.

apply.text: You smooth the scrap and count across. The last warp arrives one place too soon.

Looking reports the discrepancy without altering it; smoothing the cloth advances a remembered count and may unsettle or, if the observer stops correcting the pattern, ease slightly. Meaning stays with the act of attention. No diagnosis or larger promise is made.

outcome.name: warp-count scrap

apply.text: You draw the cord across the palm. It does not grow, yet the last knot comes late.

outcome.continuity_note: A thumb-length tarred sounding lead, salt-pitted, whose knots disagree with the span in the hand. Wear and a small length mismatch suggest distance and isolation without a passage, actor, or destination. Repeated use cools shock into familiarity; low sanity makes the weight sullen; higher insight counts the fiber error. Charges color the last slack. No quest or world effect is claimed.

apply.text: The wafer warms in assent. Your sure account gains nothing but a small, polite crack.

apply.text: You turn the clasp. The pearl cools at once, as if the warmth had been a mistake.

outcome.inspect: A loose pearl clasp. The pearl is faintly warm; the silver is not. You have no name for the difference.

apply.text: You breathe across the seam. A thin pitch answers, then stops, as if the wood reconsidered.

outcome.inspect: A wooden pitch-pipe, split along one seam. The hairline is pale and still. You are not sure it sounded.
outcome.name: Hairline Pitch Pipe

apply.text: The first look is pure courtesy. The bill is folded, not yet presented.

outcome.continuity_note: An oval mother-of-pearl glass that flatters the face holding it. With high sanity and dull insight, the first use changes no sanity; repetition, a last charge, low sanity, or sharper insight costs one or two. Inspection only notes warmth, lag, or a cold hinge. No bonus, quest, or unseen fact is claimed.
outcome.inspect: Mother-of-pearl, warm as a wrist. The oval shows a mouth kinder than yours.
outcome.name: The Compliment Glass

apply.text: You turn it once. The rules agree. What leaned was only the blink.

outcome.continuity_note: A paper-lined bone thimble whose ruled scrap will not hold one count. Inspection notes the shifting discrepancy; application recounts across four wrapped phases and may steady or unsettle within the allowed sanity delta. The observer can treat the lean as a crease or follow it. No quest, hidden fact, or unsupported effect is claimed.
outcome.inspect: A bone thimble lined with ruled paper. The lines are even. Then one is not.
outcome.name: Paper-Lined Thimble

apply.text: You lay the short corner down. It meets, then opens again by a hair when you let go.

outcome.continuity_note: A palm-warm brass square with one corner short of true. Hooks answer from the present frame only: calm uninsighted sight reads a hairline of fit; lower sanity sets thumb against eye; insight sharpens the shortage without opening another place. A counter of presses stops at the bound. Sanity shifts stay in the small allowed range and are the only effect claimed. No prior notes. Supplied figures were a bard, sanity 100, insight 0; they select the flattest line only, not a record of display or use.
outcome.inspect: A thin brass square, palm-warm at the edges. Three corners meet. The fourth is short by less than a line.
outcome.name: Unmet Square

apply.text: You draw it once. A note should close the phrase. Only cool silk remains.

outcome.continuity_note: A dove-grey concert ribbon with one thread that looks wet and is not. Its fray suggests an unfinished cadence that shifts with use and never quite coheres into a name. Looking stays sensory; drawing may chill a still-steady mind, briefly steady a badly shaken one, or, once the fray can shift no more, leave only pale silk.
outcome.inspect: Dove-grey silk, neatly hemmed, save one thread that shines as though wet.
outcome.name: Pallid Concert Ribbon

apply.text: You side with the written total. The pale stroke looks like hesitation, not absence, and the account closes.

outcome.continuity_note: Ivory clerk slip with two matching totals and one pale uncounted stroke. The confident hand outruns the marks. Inspection changes with charges, sanity, insight, and handling: full assurance at first, agreement mistaken for proof after use, a legible one-stroke gap once insight appears, louder ink if sanity is low. Apply either trusts the sum or the marks, returns a small sanity delta, and does not revise the slip or imply any further reckoning.
outcome.inspect: A narrow ivory slip ruled in a steady clerk's hand. Two totals match. One stroke in the column is only half-inked.
outcome.name: Certain Slip

apply.text: You turn the plummet. One face is colder, and the cord's shadow falls a finger long.

outcome.continuity_note: A palm-sized salt-crusted sounding lead with a hand-short cord. Wear and a pale groove suggest a drop of uncertain scale, never a passage or pursuer. Inspect only reports the discrepancy; apply advances a wear-state and a small sanity delta from sanity, insight, charges, and state, then repetition flattens the unease.
outcome.inspect: A palm-sized sounding lead, salt in the seam. The cord is no longer than your hand.
outcome.name: Frayed Sounding Plummet

apply.text: You tip the pin out. FULL appears. Both statements are now wrong.

outcome.continuity_note: A brass thimble whose label and contents contradict, then trade errors: EMPTY while a pin sits inside, FULL when the cup is hollow. Repetition makes the reversal too exact for a joke. High sanity with insight 0 keeps the error domestic; thin sanity or insight above 500 makes the same logic feel involuntary. Authoring proposal only; not installed, admitted, placed, or seen.
outcome.inspect: A brass thimble labeled EMPTY, with a bright unashamed pin.
outcome.name: The Contrary Thimble

apply.text: You set it on edge. A high thin line replaces the face. There is no width left for echo.

outcome.continuity_note: A palm-sized brass square read edge-on, so a face becomes a line and any second thickness stays unprovable. Inspect and apply change with sanity, insight, charges, and how often that edge has already been counted. The high thin tone is a craft echo of recorded whistling, not a claim this square met those whistles or any later event.
outcome.inspect: A palm-sized brass square, ruled once. Edge-on it is only a line, and the line is silent.
outcome.name: Edgewise Brass Square

apply.text: You lift the reed. A high, sure tone seems to complete itself. Nothing in the cane moved. The sureness lingers, unearned.

outcome.continuity_note: A split-cane curio whose inked tick is surer than the faint note under it. Inspection sets that confident mark against modest wood. A first unexamined assent may steady slightly; repeated assent costs composure, more so if composure is already low; a late dry tick shifts nothing. The high tone is the reed's discrepancy, not a claimed hearing or any effect beyond the sanity delta.
outcome.inspect: A split cane no longer than a thumb. A firm tick sits beside a note too faint to name. You feel you already agree.
outcome.name: Agreeing Reed

apply.text: You open the lip-case and practice a smile of sound. The gilt approves; something private does not.

outcome.continuity_note: Gilt lip-case, a vanity reed-rest. Polish flatters the mouth into a performed note. Inspection varies by charges, sanity, insight, and openings. Use creases the silk: ease may cost composure, strain on a later opening may grant a small courtesy, and the last polish leaves the mouth slightly false. The high note answers recorded whistling without a listener, quest, or unshown fact.
outcome.inspect: A slim gilt lip-case, silk-lined. The mirror corrects your mouth, as if a finished note were owed.
outcome.name: Gilt Lip-Case

apply.text: You walk the knots with a thumb. The long gap does not shorten. For a breath the room feels farther than the twine.

outcome.continuity_note: Palm of salt-stiff sounding twine; knot gaps suggest a depth the hand cannot confirm. Wear and uncertain scale only; no passage or actor. First handling at sanity 50+ unsettles slightly; lower sanity finds the mismatch familiar and steadies a little. Later recounts shift the gap. Tone follows supplied role and sanity 75, insight 0, which hooks cannot read as role. Recounting echoes quoted backtracks as craft, not as sighting, cause, or next event.
outcome.inspect: Salt has stiffened a palm of twine. Most knots sit a finger apart; one gap runs long, and nothing in the lay accounts for it.
outcome.name: Frayed Sounding Twine

apply.text: You turn it. The waterline stays. Only the word empty departs, and full comes to stand there.

outcome.continuity_note: A contrary teaspoon whose empty and full names trade places when turned, while a waterline stays put. Inspection states the mismatch; use reverses the sentence and returns a small sanity delta bounded by facing, sanity, and charges. Insight only sharpens wording. Supplied fountain refresh and wizard role are motifs, not events the spoon witnesses or completes.
outcome.inspect: The teaspoon is empty. Still, a thin waterline waits above the metal, as if fullness were a facing.
outcome.name: Contrary Teaspoon

apply.text: A tidier face. Orange-flower, then metal, one degree too exact.

outcome.continuity_note: A chipped-enamel thumb-glass whose flattery is one degree too exact. Wilde's polish sets a tidy self-image against its cost; repetition makes the preferred angle arrive early. Only a badly frayed holder is steadied, and only at first. High insight names the correction. The counter stops at its cap. No quest or hidden fact is claimed.
outcome.inspect: It straightens the collar by a hair, and seems pleased.
outcome.name: The Enamel Thumb-Glass

apply.text: You tilt the slip. A high, thin pitch almost answers, then stops short of a name.

outcome.continuity_note: An ivory slip whose one between-note nearly coheres, then withholds. High thin pitch echoes recorded whistles as atmosphere, not as a transcript or later fact. Uses vary the gap, the quiet, or a small steadiness. No other effect, quest, or agent is claimed.
outcome.inspect: Ivory slip, five hairline rules. One note sits between them, as if a high tone were left unfinished.
outcome.name: Pallid Interval Slip

apply.text: Breath finds a high, thin edge in the bore. It is almost a held note, and almost only wax.

outcome.continuity_note: Wax-sealed pitch-pipe. The hairline is recounted as state rises: flaw or light at high sanity, a shift when sanity is lower, and later a high thin tone that feels remembered rather than heard. Hooks use only sanity, insight, charges, and state. The high register is a motif beside observed high sounds, not armed attention, a companion, or any later event. Insight sharpens doubt. Sanity deltas stay small and uneasy.
outcome.inspect: A thumb-length pitch-pipe. One pale hairline crosses the wax; it may be a flaw, or only the light.
outcome.name: Waxed Pitch-Pipe

apply.text: You press the hem. One bar thickens. You may still call it only thumb-warmth.

outcome.continuity_note: A stiff hem-cloth card whose woven bars change meaning under attention. The holder may call the irregularity wear, a rest, or nothing. Finite and ambiguous; no diagnosis, quest, or claim that whistle, death, or placement occurred.
outcome.inspect: Stiff cloth, bars woven even. You may call them rests, or only threads.
outcome.name: Scored Hem Card

apply.text: A dry tick. The print names a high note; the wax answers with no pitch at all.

outcome.continuity_note: A waxed slip prints a certainty that everyone heard one high note, against evidence of only wax, type, and a thumb. Hooks vary by charges, state, insight, and sanity: first a dry tick, then a little unease if that claim is granted at no insight, a little ease if sanity is low, and a distinct last press. High-note wording cautiously neighbors reported high sounds; it records neither those sounds, a crowd, nor any later event.
outcome.inspect: Thumb-sized, waxed thin. It states that everyone heard one high note. Nothing here agrees.
outcome.name: Waxed Consensus Slip

apply.text: You press the pale worn place. The reed gives, shorter than the breath it seems to recall.

outcome.continuity_note: A salt-stiff pocket reed whose brine cracks suggest a false length, not a passage. Inspection shifts with uses left, prior presses, sanity, and insight. Apply walks give, overlong grain, then either a too-large pocket or a shut seam, and holds. Sanity moves by at most one. No listener or later event is claimed.
outcome.inspect: A small reed, salt-stiff and ordinary, until the cracks seem longer than the wood.
outcome.name: Salt-stiff Reed

apply.text: You lay edge to edge. They meet, then one is short, as if a stopped note left a gap.

outcome.continuity_note: A wafer-thin brass square whose edges disagree by a hair and never open another side. Comparison count, sanity, insight, and remaining charge change what the surface seems to admit. At the given high sanity and zero insight, the first setting-together is dismissed; later ones unsettle slightly. A high thin sound lies along the brass as an uncertain impression, akin to whistling already noticed, and stops there.
outcome.inspect: A brass square, thinner than a card. A high thin sound seems to stop at the near edge.
outcome.name: ruled brass square

apply.text: You open it. The lid improves you by one courtesy. You almost thank an object for the favor.

outcome.continuity_note: Original gilt visiting-card case: a social mirror that improves the face by one courtesy, then repeats it until the courtesy resembles a debt. Lines vary with sanity, insight, charges, and prior openings. A reluctant hinge and a late strange note lightly echo recorded door-reluctance and strange whistling, without causes, companions, placement, or later events.
outcome.inspect: A visiting-card case, gilt, suited to a wizard. The lid is kinder than any honest mirror.
outcome.name: visiting-card case

apply.text: You turn the crisp slip. Nothing is titled. A curl is simply missing.

outcome.continuity_note: A glove-thin ivory programme slip whose title stays blank and whose ornamental curl is one short. Turning it shifts a warmth or the place of the omission; a last thread can part; sanity moves only by a small chill, a lost count, or a brief steadiness. Insight cannot finish the line. The motif echoes a recorded pattern of retracing, a confirmed prayer, and a death, without treating that history as witness, placement, or any promised return.
outcome.inspect: Crisp ivory, glove-thin. The title is blank; one curl lacks its twin.
outcome.name: Ivory Programme Slip

apply.text: You set it edge-on. Thickness becomes a line, then a face with one corner late.

outcome.continuity_note: A ruled card, the Hairline Square, withholds one corner from any single angle of regard. Hooks branch on sanity, insight, charges, and state; apply only turns or retraces the card, moves state within 0..255, and shifts Sanity by -1 or 0. History quotes show backtracking, prayer, and a death result at full vitals; those are not treated as placement, attention, or future facts. The rim-retrace is the card's, not a claimed replay of those events.
outcome.inspect: A dry square of card. The hairline looks faintly damp, and it stops short of the near corner.
outcome.name: Hairline Square

apply.text: Only the order of two words has changed: blow higher, hear lower. The card calls that sufficient.

outcome.continuity_note: A ruled card whose faces reverse one instruction, so higher and lower trade places by wording alone. High composure and no insight can leave the first face neutral; the reverse lets that sentence arrive too early. The supplied whistle motif is a tonal echo only, not evidence a note was sent, answered, or attended.
outcome.inspect: A small ruled card. One face says blow higher to hear lower. The other says that, only reversed.
outcome.name: Contrary Pitch Card

apply.text: You press the bead flat. It rises again, counted, as if the thumb were late.

outcome.continuity_note: A resin tuning peg whose single bead is recounted until the measure feels unreliable. A four-face state returns to the first face; sanity, insight, and charges change the reading. Use unsettles a steady mind, more after the second face, and may ease a badly shaken mind by one on an early press when insight is slight. Retracing is cadence only, not a witnessed event or a promised return.
outcome.inspect: A black peg, thumb-smooth. One resin bead sits where no string was wound.
outcome.name: Resin Tuning Peg

apply.text: You lift the reed. A high, clean tone almost completes the line, then politely fails.

outcome.continuity_note: A rose-silk case holds a split reed and a cadence printed one note short. Looks and uses change with charges, sanity, insight, and how often the unfinished phrase is pressed. The line never completes, and the text claims no witness, errand, or cause for any prior whistle or whisper.
outcome.inspect: A slim case of faded rose silk. Inside, a split reed and a cadence printed one note short.
outcome.name: Rose-Silk Reed Case

apply.text: You count the pleats. Fourteen, then thirteen. The pinpricks do not correct you.

outcome.continuity_note: Starch-linen pleat tally: pinpricks and pleats disagree only while counted. Inspection describes; application counts, stops, or recounts, moving state and sanity by at most two. Higher composure can close the fold. No quest or hidden cause is claimed. Supplied backtracking suggested a count revised by attention; prayer, whispers, and the recorded death are not narrated as witnessed, nor treated as status.
outcome.inspect: A starched linen strip, pinpricked at the hem. The pleats look even until you count them.
outcome.name: Pleat Tally

apply.text: You let the gilt correct your mouth. The improvement is exquisite, and slightly stolen.

outcome.continuity_note: Gilt reed case: inner silver flatters a breath ahead of the holder. Inspect shifts with uses left, prior corrections, composure, and insight. Apply costs a little ease for the first stolen correction, calls the next mere style, and spends a little more to close the last brightness. A finished high pitch echoes observed whistle tones only as the object's discrepancy, not as a witnessed act, armed attention, or later event.
outcome.inspect: Too finely gilt for a reed case. Your lip looks surer than it feels, the note already ended.
outcome.name: Gilt Reed Case

apply.text: The highest notch almost proves the note. Almost is all this horn can honestly do.

outcome.continuity_note: Original horn tally whose scratch calls a high note settled while three uneven notches never prove it. Wording shifts with handling, sanity, and insight, so confidence frays or briefly loosens without a choir, a summons, or any later hearing. The high-note motif only neighbors noticed sound; it does not record whistles.
outcome.inspect: Three uneven notches mark a thin horn slip. A scratch says the high note was settled. Unused, it still reads as if the matter were closed.
outcome.name: Assent Slip

apply.text: You press the gap. Skin-oil darkens it. You almost hear a thin high tone, then decide you did not.

outcome.continuity_note: A small card of misruled vellum: staff lines that stop a hair short, and a gap attention keeps wanting to finish. Repeated looking turns the miss into skin-oil, then a figure that may be a held note or only a thumb. Enough insight lets the looker leave it unfinished; pressed attention can unsettle by a little. The doubted high tone is a motif beside the supplied sound notices, not knowledge the card possesses. Nothing here assigns identity, admission, placement, discovery, or the recorded death.
outcome.inspect: A thumb-sized card. Faded staff lines stop a hair short of joining. The gap looks accidental.
outcome.name: Misruled Card

apply.text: You turn it. The sentence you believed is now the one printed against the table.

outcome.continuity_note: A cream calling card whose rule denies the face being read. Inspection and use answer by sanity, insight, charges, and a short state cycle: each use reverses the denial and shifts sanity by one in opposite directions above and below fifty, or by none above five hundred insight. The reversal rhymes with retraced steps in the supplied history without treating that history as the card's knowledge or as a future event.
outcome.inspect: A cream card. This face says the other is blank. This face is not.
outcome.name: The Recanting Card

apply.text: You tilt the phial. The waterline lags, then settles one tick too high. The error will not leave the eye.

outcome.continuity_note: Sealed phial whose etched waterline lags the tilt. Hooks vary by sanity, insight, charges, and a measuring-count in state, so the same bead moves from optical error to obsessive arithmetic; composure shifts only within the allowed delta. Still water lightly echoes a noticed fountain refresh without tying the object to that drink, the recorded death, or any admission, placement, or notice.
outcome.inspect: A sealed glass phial. The waterline sits a hair below the etched mark, and will not agree with the tilt.
outcome.name: Late-Line Phial

apply.text: You set the reed to your lip. It scrapes high and thin, not the agreed note. The miss is small, and hard to leave alone.

outcome.continuity_note: Split reed inked ALL AGREE. A thin high scrape set against a confident claim, after Mackay's interest in credulity, with no crowd and no secret authority. State counts soundings. Sanity moves by at most one when the claim outruns the wood, or when the split steadies a frayed reading. Prose may neighbor a high whistle already in view; hooks do not read history, and nothing here is a promised event.
outcome.inspect: A thumb-dark reed, split at the lip. Ink on the grain says ALL AGREE. The hand was sure; the wood is not.
outcome.name: Concord Reed

apply.text: The north line is continuous, only a groove. The horn does not answer.

outcome.continuity_note: A horn plate scored with a square that stops short of its own start. Looking and tracing stay on the surface; the gap is a length that will not meet, once likened to a note held past the bar, never a passage or a later errand. Allowed sanity deltas mark the miss, its repetition, or a high-insight acceptance of that bound of view.
outcome.inspect: A pale horn plate. A hairline square nears the rim and stops short of its start.
outcome.name: Unjoined Square

apply.text: You keep the calmer mouth a moment too long, and the vanity cools.

outcome.continuity_note: A gilt pocket glass whose flattery is a little too finished. Repeated looking thins the compliment. High composure pays a small cost for keeping the kinder mouth; very low composure may meet a plainer, briefly steady likeness. Insight only makes the silvering hesitate. Nothing beyond the present glance is promised.
outcome.inspect: The gilt is warmer than pocket-metal ought to be. A calmer mouth waits.
outcome.name: Courtesy Glass

apply.text: You tilt the slip. Paper only. Then a thin discrepancy: the hush sits a half-step high.

outcome.continuity_note: A bone-pale calling-slip withholds a pitch one step too high. Looks and pressures worry the same hairline; if composure still has room, one use eases the gap, otherwise the hush thins by a small allowed shift. Sensation only: no named myth, no opened door, no promised errand.
outcome.inspect: Bone-pale card, one corner breathed thin. The score is paper. A high note almost fits the crack.
outcome.name: Cracked Call-Slip

apply.text: Salt crust gives. A high thin note starts, and may be only grit.

outcome.continuity_note: Palm-sized salt-scoured brass cup whose worn bowl suggests farther dark without a passage. A high thin tone echoes repeated high whistles as residue in metal, not a call or companion. Hooks vary by sanity, insight, charges, and listening-state; use may slightly steady or unsettle within allowed deltas.
outcome.inspect: Salt still rims a palm-sized cup. The bowl looks too deep. A high thin tone may be only grit.
outcome.name: Salt-scoured Listening Cup

apply.text: You set it to your lips. The note is already fading. You have not blown.

outcome.continuity_note: Original pale lip-reed: two exact three-hole counts that cannot name the same end. Carroll reversal sits in the conditionals: an unused reed has answered, a turned collar still reads BOTH WAYS, and a note can fade before the breath. Sanity, insight, charges, and state change the discrepancy and a bounded sanity delta only. The high quiet borrows supplied whistle notices as motif, not as capture, companion, placement, or a later event.
outcome.inspect: It has not been used. It has answered. Three holes, and three from the other end, which is not this end.
outcome.name: The Twice-Ended Reed

apply.text: You turn the bead. Salt grit ticks once. The hush leans nearer, then holds, like a long deck shifting.

outcome.continuity_note: A thumb-sized salt-bitten brass bead whose hairline seam suggests a farther hush than the room. Turning shifts grit and nearness; repetition wears that suggestion without opening a passage or naming an actor. Tone is tangible isolation and uncertain scale. Quoted strange sounds and foul water remain atmosphere only, not acts this object continues or confirms.
outcome.inspect: A thumb of salt-bitten brass. The seam is a hair, yet the hush beyond it feels farther than the room.
outcome.name: Saltbit Sounding Bead

apply.text: You smooth the nap across. It lies, then springs back a hair.

outcome.continuity_note: A bias-cut page-mark ribbon. Looking and smoothing shift the nap and spoil a rib-count; stopping leaves the quarrel in the act of attention, not in a revealed fact. Quoted backtracking and an expired door-reluctance whisper suggested fold-hesitation and recounting only as motifs. They do not establish placement, notice, or any later event.
outcome.inspect: A page-mark ribbon, cut on the bias. Nap lies left. You cannot yet say whether the cloth is lying.
outcome.name: Bias Seam

apply.text: You turn the cap. The hairline flashes, pitched high, as if answering a whistle not present.

outcome.continuity_note: Split brass reed-cap whose hairline seems pitched a little high. Inspect reports the seam; apply worries it, advances state within bounds, and returns a sanity delta of 0, -1, or -2 as repetition makes the reading less sure. High-pitch wording echoes recorded whistle sounds as atmosphere only, and claims no quest, attribute, or hidden fact.
outcome.inspect: A brass reed-cap, split by one hairline. No breath stirs it, yet the lip seems pitched a little high.
outcome.name: Hairline Reed
